name: Boku to Kanojo no Kojin Lesson
source:
"What should I do with my future?"

Kido Yusuke was at a crossroads, struggling with this question. He had worked hard in school to keep as many doors open as possible for his future. He also had a part-time job to save some money. But when it came to figuring out what he really wanted to do, he was stumped. Worse yet, he felt he had no one to talk to.

Then, unexpectedly, a teacher named Tsukimori Misaki moved into his student dorm.

"From today on, I'm living here," she said. "I know we're teacher and student, but let's get along."

Suddenly sharing his space with an older authority figure, Yusuke asked her what bothered him: "How do you figure out what you want to do with your life?"

Her advice was straightforward: "Broaden your horizons," she said. "Live your student life to the fullest. Experience new things."

That sounded easier said than done. Yusuke didn't know where to start; he had always played it safe.

"In that case, would you like some help?" Misaki offered.

Thus began a new chapter in Yusuke's life. Living under the same roof with Misaki, each day began to slowly change him, nudging him toward a clearer understanding of his future.
translation:
“我的未来该怎么办？”

木户佑介正处于十字路口，为这个问题而苦苦挣扎。他在学校努力学习，为自己的未来敞开尽可能多的大门。为了省点钱，他还打了一份兼职。但当他真正明白自己到底想做什么时，他却陷入了困境。更糟糕的是，他觉得没有人可以倾诉。

然后，出乎意料的是，一位名叫月森美咲的老师搬进了他的学生宿舍。

“从今天起，我就住在这里了，”她说。“我知道我们是老师和学生，但我们相处吧。”

佑介突然与一位年长的权威人物分享他的空间，他问她是什么困扰着他：“你如何弄清楚你一生想要做什么？”

她的建议很简单：“拓宽你的视野，”她说。“充分享受你的学生生活。体验新事物。”

这听起来说起来容易做起来难。佑介不知道从哪里开始；他一向谨慎行事。

“既然如此，需要帮忙吗？”美咲提出。

佑介人生的新篇章就这样开始了。与美咲生活在同一屋檐下，每一天都开始慢慢改变他，促使他对自己的未来有了更清晰的认识。
